orchid-accent.$description: Orchid Accent — Highlighted word in display headlines, decorative emphasis — vivid violet that draws the eye to a single concept within a monochrome headline

iris-brand.$description: Iris Brand — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cobalt-spark.$description: Cobalt Spark — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary body text, heading text, strong borders, and iconography

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, input backgrounds

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark surface level, input borders on dark mode, secondary dark fills

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, dividers, subtle card edges — the lightest structural neutral

fog.$description: Fog — Muted text, secondary borders, disabled states — mid-gray for de-emphasis

ash.$description: Ash — Placeholder text, low-priority labels, trust-logo grayscale

slate.$description: Slate — Helper text, input placeholder, secondary metadata

privacy-banner-gradient.$description: Privacy Banner Gradient — Gradient wash for announcement bar — soft pink fading to lavender white

poppins.$description: Primary UI and display typeface — geometric sans handling everything from 64px display headlines (weight 500-600, tight tracking) down to 11px labels. Weight 600-700 for buttons and emphasis, 400 for body, 500 for subheadings. The 0.0770-0.3000em tracking on 11-12px sizes creates wide-tracked eyebrow labels ('ENTERPRISE AI PLATFORM', 'WRITER AGENT') that anchor section hierarchy.

caneladeck.$description: Editorial body accent — a custom serif used sparingly at body size to add an editorial undertone to the otherwise sans-serif system. Its presence at 16px is signature: the serif detail in body copy signals premium editorial design rather than pure SaaS utility.
